title: Earth: Our Shared Home
summary: Waste and pollution, the 3 Rs, and how we can protect plants, animals and resources.

cbse.chapter: Our Wondrous World (2025) Ch 10: Earth: Our Shared Home

objectives: I can sort waste into wet and dry.
